en.description:
The story takes place on a beautiful and mysterious land, where lives a variety of bizarre monsters. Each trainer has a dream in his mind -- to get his fondest monsters in search of this land and fight with them.
 [Features of the game]
--Explore this vast and mysterious mainland
It’s worthwhile to search everywhere on this vast expanse of land. Defeat the annoying monsters and BOSSES that block your way; Help troubled inhabitants solve their problems in exchange for rich rewards; Bargain with vendors to buy rare goods. Moreover, lairs with haunting creeps, formidable force and ancient treasury in the desert ruins… They are all waiting for you.
--Utilize the restraint relationship to build various teams
The nine type monsters, with different skills and talents, reinforce and neutralize each other. Based on their restraint relationship, you can create a variety of teams -- Weather Group, Double Blade, Control Center… There’re only teams that you cannot image, yet no teams that you cannot build!
--Train strongest monsters through various ways
Upgrade brings higher level; Star-up increases stats growth; Awaken unlocks new skills. Also, skill upgrade, talent activation, personality cultivation… Training though various ways helps you get more and stronger monsters.
--Dominate the glorious ancient battlefield
Settle in this ancient battlefield with your dreaming monsters and fight with them in this place filled with treasures and dangers. Here, you may encounter close friends but also dreadful enemies. Who shall laugh last？
--Delicate and powerful training base
Bring the rare recipes gained through the adventures to the Blacksmith. Craftsmen there will prepare necessities for your next journey. Collect magic books scattered throughout the land. Learners in the holy Shrine will study the sealed magic to make you more powerful. Every time you come back to the base, it is for the purpose of travelling farther.

Are you ready to fight for your chance to become the best monster trainers? Download Haypi Monster 3 and start your adventure now!

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
● New Feature
- Obtain spirits by extracting spare monsters. Exchange specific monsters with the spirits.

● Optimizations
- Increased the default slots in Market to 6 places.
- You can unlock more slots in Market now by upgrading magic "Business Prosperity".
- You can refresh the Market with less money now.
- Slightly increased the income of defeating Wandering Monsters.
- Increased the honor income bonus of your Score points ranking.
- Increased the rewards in Trainer Guild.
- Increased the rewards in Blue Underground Treasury.
- Increased the materials and runestones income on raiding Creeps.
- You can gain more Funds and Donations by Donate Coin now.
- Optimized the daily Catapult times according to the battlefield location of your City.

● Monster Adjustments
- Now Neo and Electoe had 50% chance to activate "Thunder Storm" (Talent) in non-Storm Weather.
- The damage reduction effect of "Raiden Shelter" (Talent) has been increased to 15%. And the talent effect will grow 1.5% by each level up.
- Increased the PP consumption of "Psybeam" (No.1 skill) of Psyhoe from 1PP to 2PP.
- Bluestocky will use "Mountain God" (No.2 Skill) in priority now.

● Bug Fixed
- Fixed the abnormal status while deleting friends.
- Fixed a bug that prevents you from expelling league member.
- Fixed issue error in partial activities. 
- Bug fixed and performance improvement.

● New Features
- Underground Adventure: Deploy your monster squad, raid Underground Adventure and win bountiful treasure!
- Map 17 is now available.
- You can now hire another Blacksmith and manufacture two different items in the same time.

● Optimizations
- Challenge other trainers in Ladder to win bonus Honor Values. The higher rank you have, the more values you can obtain.
- Optimize the battle experience for plundering Creeps.
- Optimized the effect of Defense Facility. This facility will now reduce the royalty decrease by 30% on each attack. Last for 3 activations.
- Increased the defensive area of stationed team by 1 grid. Your stationed teams are allowed to defend your ally's grids now.
- The buff value of Magic is more accurate now by rounding values number to 1 decimal place.
- Market no longer required Lv.3 BUSINESS PROSPERITY for unlocking Legendary Monsters' mutation materials. You're allowed to find these materials when reaching Trainer level 12.
- You can find Awaken Materials for Icycro, Kung-fu, Robo and Voodoo in Market now.
- You can find Mutation Materials for Articro, Armbo and Terrar in Market now.
- Die deutschsprachige Version von Haypi Monster 3 ist ab sofort auf Teil Ger?ten erh?ltlich. (The German language version of Haypi Monster 3 is now available on partial devices.)

● Monster Adjustment
- You can mutate the following monsters now: Articro, Armbo and Terrar.

● Bug Fixes
- Fixed a random crash problem in Monster Combat.
- Fixed the crash issue by Scout Camp Report when there're more than 4 types of items in the Camp.
- Fixed a random bug of losing Monster that obtained from Underground Treasury.  
- Fixed the problem in Scout Report that prevents resources from displaying properly.
- Bug fixed and performance improvement.

● Optimizations
- Redesigned the Gift Pack System
- Adjusted the price of Truce items and Migration Token.
- You can now hire a second Gold miner.
- Camp team can attack other

● Monster Adjustment
- Seafoam, the new Legendary monster, is available in this version.
- Hippo Talent：Slight increased the chance of activating Swallow, Hippo's talent. Swallow can hurt legendary or better monsters now and this talent will revive Hippo's HP.

● New Features
- Map 18 is now available.
- The Underground Adventure of Map 6-8 is now available.

● Optimizations
- Added requirement description of raiding Instance and Boss in Underground Adventure.
- Now you can see the activity scores of your allies in League Activity.
- Added gameplay instructions in Battlefield.
- Optimized the monster description page in Encyclopedia.
- Adaptive with iPhone Xs Max

● Monster Adjustment
- You can mutate the following Epic monsters now: Agie, Eletrometal and Purrfection.

● Bug Fixes
- Fixed the issue that causes delay of spawning Cheeky in Venture map.
- Fixed a small probability bug that causes Stamina using error while entering the Instance.
- Fixed a random problem that displays incorrect negative number PP in combat.
- Fixed the problem that Talent 'Speedy' didn't take effect.
- Bug fixed and performance improvement.

- Expanded the Underground Adventure to Map 12.
- Added a new event, the new comer carnival.
- The new version offers you daily free chances for each egg-hatch way.
- You can find back yesterday's recyclable resources with coin now.
- A new look for the Phoenix Town.
- Added a new building, the Treasury Hall.
- Removed the cool-down of raiding on partial Venture Instances.
- You can purchase the Stamina now.
- Added quick access introduction of partial items to help in finding the general way of obtaining them.
- Optimized the rounds of quickly ending combat from 30 to 10.
- You're now allowed to see the edge line of all types of map.
- In auto combat mode, double tap on the vulnerable opponent target to cancel the concentrate attack.

● Monster Optimizations
- Boey, the new Legendary monster, is available in this version.
- While the talent Benediction of Podhi was being activated, it consumed the PP if Podhi used the skill, Bless. After awakening Podhi, the PP costs of skill, Bless, would be reduced from 3 to 2 PP.

- Fixed the bug that prevents the talent, Thorny Polish, of Cybones from working properly.

Fixed the issue that prevents the animation being correctly played.

Fixed a random bug which causes game crash while switching maps.
Fixed the abnormal display issue in the grid of Verdant Cavern on battlefield.
Bug fixed and performance improvement.
